mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.username, o.total_price, o.status, o.create_time, o.pay_time, o.refund_time FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.id = #{id};

SELECT oi.id AS itemId, m.name AS movieName, m.poster_url AS posterUrl, h.name AS hallName, h.location, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, oi.seat_row AS seatRow, oi.seat_col AS seatCol, oi.price FROM order_item oi JOIN `session` s ON s.id = oi.session_id JOIN movie m ON m.id = s.movie_id JOIN hall h ON h.id = s.hall_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{id}
